description: For an injection b from X into Y, H is homogeneous in colour i for the pulled-back colouring exactly when b[H] is homogeneous in i for the original colouring.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.pullback_homogeneousIn.{u, v, w} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {K : Type w} {n : ℕ}
  (e : α ↪ β) (c : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.Coloring β n K) (H : Set α) (i : K) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.pullback e c) H i ↔
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn c (⇑e '' H) i
